sara_ml: bringing up lycan14b v2 (int4) on canary nodes — hitting occasional OOMs when session length + max_new_tokens spikes. short thread with current notes and a proposed quick fix.

jordan: thanks, what's the failure mode? frag or peak alloc?

sara_ml: reproducible on 2g instances with batch=2, max_new_tokens=1024; allocator shows sudden peak when kv cache grows + prefetch. logs: `oom_alloc failed at 3.9G while trying to reserve 256M`

liam: likely memory fragmentation from warm KV growth + kernel not releasing holes. seen similar with kyros13b.

maya: can we mitigate by lowering default max_new_tokens for this model to 384 and enable session-level kv-prune for idle sessions? that reduces steady state footprint.

sara_ml: I ran a quick local perf test: batch=2, max_new=1024 -> 1/20 requests OOM; batch=2, max_new=384 -> 0/500 OOMs but tail latency slightly higher for long completions. quality evals looked fine for typical prompts.

jordan: what about prefetch window? we currently prefetch 256 steps for this arch, maybe shrinking it to 96 for int4 reduces peak.

sara_ml: yes, tried prefetch=96: memory peak dropped ~420MB and OOMs disappeared in the smoke run. tradeoff: throughput down ~3% for very long sequences.

liam: propose quick configuration patch for canary: 1) model default max_new_tokens = 384 2) prefetch_steps = 96 3) session_kv_ttl = 60s for inactive sessions 4) enable kv-trim-on-alloc-fail true (soft eviction).

maya: +1 to kv-ttl and prefetch patch. but add a guard: if client explicitly sets max_new_tokens > 512, route to dedicated capacity only (or fall back to lower-priority queue). prevents noisy tenants from killing canary.

sara_ml: agreed. I'll open a tiny rollout PR with config json below and request a quick canary deploy.

sara_ml: ```json
{
  "model": "lycan14b-v2-int4",
  "defaults": {
    "max_new_tokens": 384,
    "prefetch_steps": 96,
    "session_kv_ttl_secs": 60,
    "kv_trim_on_alloc_fail": true
  },
  "policy": {
    "max_new_tokens_hard_limit": 512,
    "hard_limit_action": "route_to_dedicated"
  }
}
```

ops-bot: canary deployment started for lycan14b-v2-int4 on cluster canary-3 at 2026-03-20T17:40:00Z :robot_face:

jordan: when can we get perf/oom telemetry? add a short eval run with long-chat prompts and a stress run (batch=4, variable seq).

sara_ml: running stress job now, will post numbers in ~10m. initial smoke: 500 requests (mixed lengths) -> 0 OOM, 99.8% success, p99 latency +120ms vs baseline.

liam: sounds good. next steps: if canary stable for 2h, push to autoscale pool but keep the hard limit routing. also add a shortnote to onboarding checklist about adjusting prefetch and defaults per-architecture.

maya: also capture a small prompt set for quality guardrail — if lowering max_new_tokens caused >2% perplexity or extraction regressions, roll back.

sara_ml: noted. I'll attach eval results and PR link when ready. thanks all :thumbsup:
